geometry._comment: Lengths (mm) measured off the kit maker's dimension drawing (YFROBOT 6-DOF disc arm spec sheet, same frame as Makerfabs PICO arm): about +-3 mm - check with a tape measure. kinematicZero per motor (raw angle with base forward, upper arm level, forearm and wrist in line) is still to be calibrated; until then IK uses 'rest'. kinematicSign (1 or -1): does a bigger raw angle bend the joint up (+1) or down (-1)?
